blocks.text: The query results show three individuals in the EMEA region who have Python proficiency at level 4 or higher and are less than 60% hard-booked between March and May 2026. These individuals are Edward Hill, Matthew Hill, and Matthew White. Each of them has 0.0 hard-booked hours and 0.0% hard-booked percentage during this period. The data is complete for this query and no truncation or sampling is indicated.

blocks.title: List people in EMEA with Python skill proficiency >=4 and hard-booked less than 60% between March and May 2026, including person_id, name, hard_booked_hours and hard_booked_pct.

blocks.purpose: List people in EMEA with Python skill proficiency >=4 and hard-booked less than 60% between March and May 2026, including person_id, name, hard_booked_hours and hard_booked_pct.
blocks.sql:
WITH skill_python AS (
    SELECT ps.person_id
    FROM person_skills ps
    JOIN skills s ON ps.skill_id = s.skill_id
    WHERE s.name = 'Python' AND ps.proficiency >= 4
),
person_emea AS (
    SELECT person_id, display_name
    FROM people
    WHERE location_region = 'EMEA'
),
hard_bookings AS (
    SELECT
        b.person_id,
        SUM(CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN b.start_ts < :window_start THEN
                    CASE WHEN b.end_ts > :window_start THEN b.end_ts ELSE :window_start END - :window_start
                WHEN b.start_ts >= :window_start AND b.start_ts < :window_end THEN
                    CASE WHEN b.end_ts > :window_end THEN :window_end ELSE b.end_ts END - b.start_ts
                ELSE 0
            END AS INTEGER
        )) AS hard_booked_minutes
    FROM bookings b
    WHERE b.kind = 'hard'
      AND b.status_id IN (12,14) -- confirmed or closed bookings
      AND b.start_ts < :window_end
      AND b.end_ts > :window_start
    GROUP BY b.person_id
),
capacity AS (
    SELECT :capacity_hours AS capacity_hours
)
SELECT
    p.person_id,
    p.display_name AS name,
    COALESCE(hb.hard_booked_minutes, 0) / 60.0 AS hard_booked_hours,
    CASE WHEN c.capacity_hours > 0 THEN (COALESCE(hb.hard_booked_minutes, 0) / 60.0) * 100.0 / c.capacity_hours ELSE NULL END AS hard_booked_pct
FROM person_emea p
JOIN skill_python sp ON p.person_id = sp.person_id
LEFT JOIN hard_bookings hb ON p.person_id = hb.person_id
CROSS JOIN capacity c
WHERE (COALESCE(hb.hard_booked_minutes, 0) / 60.0) * 100.0 / c.capacity_hours < 60
ORDER BY p.person_id ASC;

assumptions: The date range March to May 2026 is interpreted as 2026-03-01 to 2026-05-31 inclusive.
Hard-booked means bookings of kind 'hard' confirmed or completed within the date range.
Proficiency 4 or higher means person_skills with skill 'Python' and proficiency >= 4.
Region EMEA is matched to people.location_region = 'EMEA'.
Less than 60% hard-booked means total hard booking allocation in the date range is less than 60% of total available time in that period.
